que_es: Beats per minute with the body at rest.

como_se_mide_en_vuelo.estacion: Wrist or garment sensor. The day's resting value, never a single isolated reading.
como_se_mide_en_vuelo.transito: Wrist or garment sensor. The day's resting value, never a single isolated reading.
como_se_mide_en_vuelo.superficie: Wrist or garment sensor. The day's resting value, never a single isolated reading.

por_que: Monitors cardiovascular adaptations, one of the HRP risks.
cuando_avisar: Extreme band of layer A (40 bpm or less; 131 or more). Persistent deviation from the baseline (layer B, two days in a row) or upward drift (layer C).
prevencion: Aerobic and resistance exercise according to the flight plan; it mitigates cardiovascular deconditioning without preventing it entirely.
fuentes: Royal College of Physicians: NEWS2 scoring table
NASA HRP: Risks of Human Spaceflight
